div.head: Cn 1018 8
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is. þæt wiðersacan 7 utlagan godes. 7 manna. of earde gewitan buton hi gebugon. 7 þe geornor gebetan.
And witena gerædnes is þæt wiðersacan and utlagan Godes and manna of earde gewitan, buton hi gebugon and þe geornor gebetan.
And the decree of the councillors is that apostates and outlaws, both of God and of men, shall depart from the land, unless they submit and the more zealously make amends.
And the council’s decree is that apostates and those in defiance of the laws of God and the realm are to leave this land unless they submit and most sincerely repent.
